halt.text:
io cannot protect this folder on this computer: this computer's settings (Ubuntu's AppArmor rule for user namespaces) do not let the wall start. All three settings need that protection, so Codex is switched off here for now.

An administrator can allow it once, in a terminal:
  cd /home/beeps/src/github.com/bprashanth/io/benchmarks/runs/2026-09-14-io-codex/drive-halt/data
  sudo install -m 644 io-bwrap /etc/apparmor.d/io-bwrap && sudo apparmor_parser -r /etc/apparmor.d/io-bwrap

Then start io again.
